explication: Agent Notifications is a cross-platform desktop alert and click-to-focus product for Claude Code and Codex CLI. The principal workflow is agent hook events entering the Go CLI, being interpreted and enriched with session/project context, filtered and deduplicated by policy, then delivered through desktop notifications, sound, or optional webhooks. Setup and configuration manage each agent’s hooks and settings; the README also documents terminal targeting, sound controls, focus-aware delivery, and webhook integrations. The graph follows documented capabilities where source excerpts were unavailable; those branches use exact enclosing paths from the tree.
